name: Koi Naam Na Do
overview: Set in Mumbai, this compelling BL series follows two men shaped by their pasts who find an unexpected sense of comfort in each other’s presence. What begins as a deep friendship gradually turns into a painful dilemma when one of them falls deeply in love, while the other, who is straight, can only offer friendship. The story dives into the complexity of unrequited love, exploring the delicate line between platonic affection and romantic desire. Facing the pain of rejection and the courage to stay beside the one he loves, the series raises a powerful question: do profound feelings need labels, or can they simply exist freely, without definition?
